transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Sunday, November 22. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 9 family members killed as pilgrims' vehicle crashes into truck in Rajasthan. Nine individuals died in a tragic accident involving a vehicle carrying family members in Rajasthan. The group was returning home from visiting a religious shrine in Khatu Shyam. The accident occurred near Shambhupura on the Kota-Udaipur highway during the night. Authorities are ensuring that the injured receive the necessary medical treatment and care. Watch: Missile seen approaching aircraft in video as Iran claims US F-16 was hit. Iran has released footage claiming it struck a US F-16 fighter jet over the Persian Gulf. The video purportedly shows a missile hitting the aircraft, causing an emergency landing. While Washington denied the claim, insisting no F-16 was attacked, Iran insisted on its air defense's action against the aircraft. It clarified the operation was conducted by the Iranian Army's Air Defence. 'As Mumbai Indians we feel like underdogs now': MI coach Robin Uthappa. Robin Uthappa's appointment as Mumbai Indians' batting coach marks a new chapter in his cricketing journey, one that has quietly taken shape through individual coaching over the past few years. He discusses his philosophy of building trust, creating a happy environment, working with established players, making technical adjustments in a fast-paced T20 format and helping MI rediscover their identity. Why Canadian billionaire Kevin O'Leary thinks Anthropic could be the next Amazon. AI giant Anthropic has celebrated a milestone initial public offering, amassing a staggering $81.3 billion, which catapults its valuation to an impressive $1.5 trillion. Kevin O'Leary, an influential investor, commended the company's enterprise-driven approach focused on instilling trust and security among business clients. Notably, Amazon holds a substantial 14.7 percent share worth $225 billion, while Alphabet, Google's parent company, controls 13. Brooklyn musician says landlord ignored cracks before collapse killed 8; sues. In the wake of a devastating building collapse in Brooklyn that claimed eight lives, a musician has taken legal action against the landlord for ignoring warnings about visible cracks weeks prior. The lawsuit also raises alarms about nearby construction projects lacking proper structural support. Authorities are now probing the oversight of such projects in densely populated neighborhoods, questioning the responsiveness to residents' concerns before the tragic incident occurred. 580 army drone tenders seek China-linked parts, industry body flags security risk. Cautioning the govt against sourcing drones with Chinese components, the country's industry body Drone Federation India (DFI) has told senior defence officials that as many as 689 tenders floated on govt e-Marketplace (GeM) by the Indian military and govt bodies over nearly six years were found to specify Chinese drones and drone components. 720/9! Team India rewrite record books, post highest-ever Test total in NZ. India's 720/9 became the biggest total ever scored in a Test innings on New Zealand soil. The previous best was the hosts' 715/6 declared against Bangladesh in Hamilton in 2019. India also broke the record for the highest Test total against New Zealand. The West Indies had earlier held the record with their 660/5 declared at the Basin Reserve in Wellington in 1995. 10-year-old Anvi swims 36 km to Gateway of India in 8.5 hours. Anvi Suvarna, a 10-year-old swimmer from Dombivli, completed a significant 36-km swim in open water. This achievement follows her earlier 17-km swim, marking notable progress in her endurance training. Her swim aimed to raise awareness about water conservation and marine pollution issues facing Maharashtra. Support from her parents has played a crucial role in her journey as a young athlete. Russian 'triple-tap' strike on Zelenskyy's hometown kills child, wounds 60. A Russian ballistic missile attack on Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's hometown of Kryvyi Rih killed two people, including a seven-year-old boy, and wounded 60 others, including six children, local officials said on Saturday. As Florida uses robot rabbits to catch pythons; study reveals when snakes climb trees. In 2025, Florida implemented solar-powered robotic rabbit decoys designed to attract Burmese pythons for removal efforts. Researchers tracked 346 pythons from 2017 to 2024 to study their climbing behavior. The study found that juvenile pythons are more likely to climb trees compared to adults. A recent competition in 2026 resulted in 280 pythons being removed by participants. Texas man accused of posing as veteran to win $1.6m contracts, supply fake gear. Marcelo Fascino, a 24-year-old from San Antonio, Texas, stands accused of securing more than $1.6 million in federal contracts by deceitfully claiming his business was owned by veterans. He allegedly misrepresented his military background, impersonated government officials, and manipulated suppliers to stifle competition. Furthermore, investigators found he sold counterfeit military gear, mislabeling it as American-made but failing to meet specifications. He faces several charges as the investigation proceeds.
